cards.issue_title: Hero headline and Explore banks button are not vertically centered in the top block
summary_4_lines: On the home page, the gap above “Get a fair view of home loans…” is not the same as the gap below the blue Explore banks button.
The headline and button should feel centered in that whole top block.
The product video under them was called fine.
This is the first thing they flagged in this review.
cards.pinpoint: Spacing above the hero headline and below the Explore banks button is uneven, so the headline and button do not feel centered in the top block.
cards.on_screen_object: Home hero block: H1 “Get a fair view of home loans and apply to your chosen banks in one go.” plus the Explore banks button
quotes_sample: First thing I see in this top block, which has the Get a Fair View of Home Loans, this text, is that the amount of spacing above this text and below the CBE is not even.
It should feel like the text and the button are in the center of this entire block.
related_discussion_one_liners: They praised the product video: video looks good, video view/code, video padding — not a complaint.
They asked “This is our photo, isn't it?” about the landscape behind the mockup — a check, not a defect.
Opening line is only that this is a co-founder review on 15 August 2026.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is uneven vertical spacing of the hero H1 and Explore banks button in the top block, not journey/Transparent copy and not the Zero scroll or commissions wording.

cards.issue_title: Home-loan journey lines use too many words and too many phrases
summary_4_lines: They like this dark block’s story: re-engineered journey, whole market in one view, look before sharing a number, pick banks and they compete.
They still want the same facts in fewer, simpler sentences — one subject, one predicate — so a reader spends less effort.
Line 1 is fine. Line 2 should be shorter. “Before you give your phone number” sounds crude. Line 4 also fails the simple-sentence test.
They were pointing at this block while saying that.
cards.pinpoint: The four-line journey story is coherent but too wordy and too clause-heavy; they want simpler polished English, especially lines 2–4, including less crude “give your phone number” wording.
cards.on_screen_object: Dark homepage block under heading “We completely re-engineered your home loan journey.” with three following lines about the market view, looking before giving a phone number/email, and picking banks / applying once / they compete
quotes_sample: But I feel we can convey the same amount of information using a lot less words by keeping the English polished still,
It should be simple, one subject, one predicate as much as possible.
So this before you give your phone number sounds a bit crude to me. This can become polished English as well.
related_discussion_one_liners: They like the coherence of the four-beat journey story; example rewrites are suggestions, not extra issues.
They briefly thought scrolling felt slow, then took it back (“No, there is no such problem with scrolling”) — not an issue.
“We have to act as a cursor / phone / text” is how they want to review, not a site defect.
They name Transparent supporting lines (issue-03) as a later, different block.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the dark journey block’s four lines being too wordy and clause-heavy (plus crude “give your phone number”), not the Transparent supporting line’s lack of value and not hero spacing or Zero issues.

cards.issue_title: “So you find what works for you — with no surprises” adds little or no value
summary_4_lines: They like the big line “Transparent, like never before.”
The smaller line under it — “So you find what works for you — with no surprises.” — they say the first half adds little and “with no surprises” adds nothing.
They want new lines that earn their place, or skip/redesign this whole stretch.
This is a different problem from the earlier journey-block wording.
cards.pinpoint: The supporting line under “Transparent, like never before.” does not add value; they would replace those sentences, skip the section, or redesign it.
cards.on_screen_object: Homepage Transparent block: heading “Transparent, like never before.” plus supporting line “So you find what works for you — with no surprises.”
quotes_sample: So you find what works for you, I don't think it adds so much value.
And with no surprises, I don't think it adds any value at all.
Let's find some sentences that add value, or let's skip this section entirely, or redesign this section.
related_discussion_one_liners: They like the main heading “Transparent, like never before.”
New sentences vs skip vs redesign are options for this one supporting-line problem, not extra issues.
They already closed the journey-block complexity issue (issue-02) before scrolling here; this is not that problem.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the Transparent supporting line adding little or no value, not the journey block’s wordiness (issue-02) and not hero spacing or Zero scroll/wording.

cards.issue_title: Scrolling into Zero commissions / Zero bias first shows two bare zeros
summary_4_lines: When they scrolled into this block they first saw two large “Zero”s and nothing else.
They had no idea what was coming and, for a moment, thought the site was broken.
They want the words to arrive with the zeros — either “Zero commissions” then “Zero bias,” or one zero, then “commissions,” then “bias.”
They clicked the first Zero while saying this.
cards.pinpoint: On scroll-in, only two zeros are visible, with no “commissions” or “bias,” so the block looks broken until the rest of the heading appears.
cards.on_screen_object: Homepage Zero block (h2#home-zero-title): two large “Zero” words that later become “Zero commissions. Zero bias.”
quotes_sample: When I scrolled down to this section, I saw two zeros on the screen.
And I had no context of what is going to come up. In fact, I felt that the website was broken.
related_discussion_one_liners: They then read the finished lines (“Zero commissions, zero bias. So you get a fair view of every lender listed on our platform.”).
Whether “commissions” is the right word is issue-05, not this reveal.
Next folder wb-rec-260815-1950 opens still on two zeros with no speech — same visual, no new talk.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the mid-scroll state of two bare zeros looking broken, not the finished “Zero commissions” wording (issue-05) and not earlier hero spacing or journey/Transparent copy.

cards.issue_title: “Zero commissions” is easy to read as the customer pays nothing
summary_4_lines: They like the intent: independent platform, no pay to push a bank, no built-in bias.
They do not think a customer will understand “commission” here — it sounds like “you pay us nothing,” not “we take nothing from the bank.”
“Zero bias” is fine only if it stays in the same customer-facing voice; they do not want the viewpoint to jump from bank to customer.
They want new words that still say no earnings from banks and no push, without making people ask how Shroffin makes money. That last point was still open when this clip ended.
cards.pinpoint: “Zero commissions” is unclear and easy to take as “no fee for me,” and “Zero bias” sits in a different viewpoint; they want one customer-facing wording that does not invite “then how do they earn?”
cards.on_screen_object: Homepage Zero block finished heading “Zero commissions. Zero bias.” and line “So you get a fair view of every lender listed on our platform, with none ranked or pushed ahead of another.”
quotes_sample: But this zero commissions, I don't think it comes across easily to the customer.
Instead of thinking that they are earning no commission from the bank.
related_discussion_one_liners: They like the independence intent and the fair-view line’s direction.
Trust talk: if we say we earn nothing, people ask how we earn, including “do they sell data?”
End-of-clip trial phrases (“no word for pay,” “we don’t have to pay the bank,” “zero commission, zero pay cuts”) are the same wording hunt, not new issues.
The two-zero scroll-in is issue-04, not this wording/perspective problem.
Wording search is unfinished at 00:09:05 when the clip ended.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is how customers may misread finished “Zero commissions” and how “Zero bias” shifts viewpoint, not the two-zero scroll reveal (issue-04) and not hero spacing or journey/Transparent copy.
